:::{#exm-marginal-slope-nonindep-interaction}

#### A marginal slope under an identity link with an interaction

Take the parameter values of @exm-marginal-mean-nonindep-interaction.
Because the marginal mean is now quadratic in $x$,
its slope varies with $x$.
The code below approximates the slope at $x = 2$ and $x = 4$ with a central difference,
and compares it with the formula of @cor-marginal-slope-nonindep-interaction:

```{r}
#| label: exm-marginal-slope-nonindep-interaction-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_marginal_mean <- function(x) {
  (0.1 + 0.1 * 1) + (0.05 + 0.1 * 0.5 + 0.02 * 1) * x + 0.02 * 0.5 * x^2
}
ex_h <- 1e-4
ex_slope_numeric <- sapply(
  c(2, 4),
  function(x) (ex_marginal_mean(x + ex_h) - ex_marginal_mean(x - ex_h)) / (2 * ex_h)
)
ex_slope_formula <- (0.05 + 0.1 * 0.5 + 0.02 * 1) + 2 * 0.02 * 0.5 * c(2, 4)
```

At $x = 2$ and $x = 4$,
the central differences are `r round(ex_slope_numeric, 4)`
and the formula gives `r round(ex_slope_formula, 4)`,
so the two agree,
and the slope increases with $x$.

:::
